Name: Magic Pegasus
Author: AbrahMods
Description:
🐎[b][i] Magic Pegasus[/i][/b]

Turn your normal horse into a magical flying Pegasus.
This mod retextures the vanilla horse into a beautiful Pegasus and gives it special abilities. It also includes a matching custom stable and a Pegasus whistle.
The Pegasus is faster than the normal horse. It can pass through objects and buildings. It can also fly.

✨ What this mod includes
• Pegasus retexture for the vanilla horse
• Custom stable retexture that matches the Pegasus theme
• Pegasus whistle retexture
• Faster movement speed
• Can pass through objects and buildings
• Flying effect
The whistle lets you summon your Pegasus wherever you want.
You can buy the Pegasus whistle from Robin for 500g.
[b][u]Important[/u][/b]
You must mount the Pegasus at least one time and give it a name before the whistle can work.
[line][b]Requirements[/b]
You must install these before using this mod:
• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
Make sure they are up to date.
[line][b]Important Installation Info[/b]
This mod contains 2 separate folders.
Do not mix the files together.
Do not place one folder inside the other.
Both folders are required for the mod to work correctly.
Place both folders directly inside your Mods folder.
Example file path:
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\MagicPegasus
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\MagicPegasusStable
Your Mods folder should look like this:
Mods
MagicPegasus
MagicPegasusStable
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
[line][b]How it works[/b]
Buy a stable as usual.
Your horse will appear as a Pegasus.
Mount it at least once and give it a name.
Buy the Pegasus whistle from Robin for 500g (optional)
Use the whistle to summon your Pegasus wherever you are.
Enjoy flying across Stardew Valley with your magical Pegasus 🐎✨
